hash_rules.request: sha256 of immutable saved canonical JSON UTF8 bytes; never normalize on read to hide changed bytes
hash_rules.scenario: sha256 canonical JSON {schema_version,scenario_id,dataset_version,spec,input,source}; excludes only ref.content_hash and separate expectations
hash_rules.canonical: UTF8/no BOM/sorted keys/compact separators/allow_nan=false; duplicate keys rejected; UUID lowercase; UTC seconds Z; null explicit; arrays retain frozen order

limitations: Design only; no domain classes, DB or generated business Schema/OpenAPI/TS implemented.
Independent N02 must judge all freeze blockers; no Gate signature by implementer.
